fusions.name: Hammerfall Rear
fusions.desc: Rears and brings both forehooves down on the target, dealing 14 damage, stunning it for 1.2 seconds and leaving it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Bucking Tantrum
fusions.desc: You buck and pound in a frenzy, dealing 28 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles, plus 4% of a boss's or elite's maximum health.

fusions.name: Unseat
fusions.desc: Every enemy that strikes you takes 50% of the damage back for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Brute Haunches

riders.text: and there is more of you to stop
and the fists come down faster

fusions.desc: Raises your Power by 1, and your Power ceiling by 1. From bronze rank you move 4% faster, from silver your maximum health rises by 10, and from gold you attack 6% faster.
